landing.heroSubtitle: Track calories and macros, plan from {{count}} recipes, and stay on top of intermittent fasting — all in one calm app instead of ten tabs.
landing.noCreditCard: No credit card needed · ready in 30 seconds
landing.screenScannerHint: Hold the barcode in the frame
landing.panel1Title: Calories & macros, without the mental math.
landing.panel1Text: Add a meal from a recipe, scan a barcode, or enter it manually — your daily goal and macro breakdown update instantly.
landing.panel2Title: Plan the week, the shopping list writes itself.
landing.panel2Text: Assign recipes to days — ingredient amounts are added up automatically and grouped by recipe.
landing.panel3Title: Fasting ring, eating window and phases explained.
landing.panel3Text: Pick a protocol, start — the ring counts down to the end of your fast and explains along the way what's happening in your body.
landing.panel4Text: Point your camera at it, done — nutrition facts are filled in automatically. For generic ingredients, the curated 681-item database kicks in.
landing.statement: No point system. No guilty conscience. Just clear numbers and really good food.
landing.recipeRailTitle: From overnight oats to Tom Kha Gai.
landing.recipeRailSubtitle: Every recipe comes with nutrition facts, an ingredient list, and tags for diet type and intolerances.
landing.fastingTitle: The ring counts. You just keep going.
landing.fastingSubtitle: 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, or your own protocol. Log it retroactively if you forget — and turn it off completely anytime.
landing.phase1Text: Digestion — your body processes the last meal
landing.changelogSubtitle: New recipes, features and improvements every week. What changes is shown openly with a date under "What's new in Nellicious" — no changelog nobody reads.
landing.pricesTitle: Start free, upgrade when it fits.
landing.pricesSubtitle: All core features stay free forever. Premium unlocks unlimited meal planning, automatic menu planning, cooking mode, fasting tracking, insights, and more — 14 days to try it, no payment details required.
landing.finalTitle: Ready for less mental overhead around food?
landing.finalSubtitle: Sign up for free, log your first day, and feel the rhythm within the first week.

fastingPhases.phase1Text: Your last meal is still being digested. Insulin is elevated, and the body covers its energy needs mainly from blood sugar.
fastingPhases.phase2Text: Insulin levels drop, and glycogen stores in the liver and muscles are increasingly tapped. Early, light fat mobilization begins.
fastingPhases.phase3Text: Glycogen reserves are running low, fat burning noticeably increases, and the liver starts producing ketone bodies.
fastingPhases.phase4Text: Ketone levels keep rising, and the brain increasingly uses ketones as an energy source. Cellular cleanup processes are activated.
